characters.summary: Ernie is Sesame Street's naive, exuberant troublemaker: he comes up with hare-brained ideas that leave his best friend Bert frustrated, and he loves his Rubber Duckie.

sources.supports: Ernie: 'the naïve and exuberant troublemaker' to Bert's 'world-weary foil'; typical sketch is Ernie's hare-brained idea leaving Bert frustrated; eats Bert's snacks and pesters him to play; trades Rubber Duckie for Bert's gift; Rubber Duckie song reached No. 16; in Follow That Bird, 'Ernie pilots the plane' while searching for Big Bird.

feats.claim: Piloted a plane with Bert while searching for Big Bird.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots the plane in Follow That Bird.

unknowns: No fights or physical feats beyond flying the plane.

characters.summary: Floyd Pepper is the sarcastic bass player of the Electric Mayhem on The Muppet Show, frequently paired with Janice and often the band's spokesman.

sources.supports: Floyd: 'bass player for the Electric Mayhem band on The Muppet Show'; 'hip sarcasm' often aimed at Miss Piggy; frequently paired with Janice; led the band in quitting over the theme song (episode 123); took Fozzie's shades away (episode 201); did most of the talking for the band against the music-making robot (episode 407); no physical feats or fights.

limitations: No physical feats or fights documented

feats.claim: Led the Electric Mayhem in quitting over the theme song, and spoke for the band against the music-making robot.

unknowns: No physical feats or fights are documented.

characters.summary: Forgetful Jones is a Sesame Street cowboy with a severe short-term memory problem who forgets names, instructions and even who he is; his horse is Buster.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

sources.supports: Forgetful Jones: Sesame Street cowboy 'so named because he always forgets everything'; 'a severe short term memory problem'; his horse is Buster; rides horseback with Clementine in 'Around the Rock'; forgets how to open a door and 'crashes through it' (Episode 1488); faces Sinister Sam in the 'High 12' parody (Episode 2614).

limitations: Forgets instructions and even his own identity

feats.claim: Forgot how to open a door and crashed through it.

campaignTags.claim: Cowboy who rides his horse Buster, and rides horseback with Clementine.

unknowns: Outcome of his 'High 12' showdown with Sinister Sam is not stated in the source.

characters.summary: Fozzie Bear is The Muppet Show's insecure stand-up comic who ends jokes with "Wocka wocka!" and is the favorite victim of hecklers Statler and Waldorf.

sources.supports: Fozzie: 'best known as the insecure and comedically fruitless stand-up comic'; 'Wocka wocka!' signals a finished joke; Statler and Waldorf's 'favorite victim'; no rubber chickens, pelting or fights mentioned.

limitations: No combat or physical feats documented in the source
unknowns: No physical feats or fights in the source; the earlier rubber-chicken and tomato-durability claims were unsourced and removed.

characters.summary: Frazzle is a growling Sesame Street monster with a child-like personality and a desperate need to be included; his snarls and roars sound the same whatever his mood.

sources.supports: Frazzle: 'a growling monster on Sesame Street'; child-like, 'a desperate need to be included'; snarls and roars sound identical regardless of mood; in a Dentist's Office sketch 'the dentist turns out to be scared of Frazzle'; no leg count given.

feats.claim: Frightened a dentist with his appearance.

unknowns: No combat or strength feats; the earlier multi-legged description was unsourced and removed.

characters.summary: Gladys the Cow is a self-obsessed cow who longs to be a star in acting, dancing or singing; her signature song is "I'm Proud to Be a Cow".

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

weaknesses: Self-obsessed; her disguises as other animals rarely fool anyone

sources.supports: Gladys: 'a rather self-obsessed bovine, aspiring to be a big star in acting, dancing, or singing'; imitates other animals but her figure gives her away; played Sleeping Beauty and a seed-turned-to-flower; signature song 'I'm Proud to Be a Cow'; tried to steal the show at Hooper's Store karaoke night; no size given.

feats.claim: Played Sleeping Beauty and a seed-turned-to-flower in local productions.

unknowns: No combat feats or documented size.

characters.summary: Gobo Fraggle is an explorer like his Uncle Traveling Matt and a good if sometimes domineering leader; he is the only Fraggle brave enough to enter Doc's Workshop for Matt's postcards.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

sources.supports: Gobo: 'an explorer, just like his Uncle Traveling Matt'; good leader but sometimes conceited and domineering; 'the only Fraggle who is brave enough to go into Doc's Workshop to pick up his uncle's postcards', evading Sprocket; reveals himself to Doc in 'The Honk of Honks'; no mention of the Gorgs.

feats.claim: Repeatedly enters Doc's Workshop and evades Sprocket to retrieve Uncle Traveling Matt's postcards.

unknowns: Combat capability; the earlier Gorg-territory weakness was unsourced and removed.

characters.summary: Grover is a lovable, timid blue monster with many jobs (waiter, taxi driver, photographer) who, as the well-meaning but inept Super Grover, flies to help children and often crash-lands.
weaknesses: Inept and accident-prone; often injures himself
Helmet visor falls over his eyes
mobility: Flight (as Super Grover, with frequent crash landings)

sources.supports: Grover: 'lovable, cute, and furry'; self-conscious and timid; slapstick, 'often accidentally injures himself'; jobs include waiter, taxi driver, photographer; Super Grover is 'flying somewhere over Metro City' and 'crash-lands nearby'; 'well-meaning but inept'; spins into a costume of cape and helmet whose visor falls over his eyes.

limitations: His Super Grover feats of strength or speed are described as only killing time

feats.claim: Flies over Metro City as Super Grover to answer children's calls for help, usually crash-landing.

conditional.dependsOn: Being in his Super Grover persona

campaignTags.claim: Super Grover flies (with frequent crash landings).

unknowns: How his flight works (whether it depends on the costume).

characters.summary: Grundgetta is Oscar the Grouch's girlfriend and best friend; she sometimes acts sweetly just to make Oscar angry.

sources.supports: Grundgetta: 'Oscar's Grouch girlfriend on Sesame Street' and his best friend; gets dolled up to act nice to make Oscar angry on his birthday; sings with a beautiful soprano voice (Episode 2052); she and Oscar called off their wedding (Episode 3609).
